description: Open a new matter from a lead: creates the Asana project from the firm's matter template in the portfolio for its Matter Type, creates the Dropbox client folder, records both on the lead, and posts one comment on the lead. Refuses unless the retainer is signed and paid, or staff_override_reason is given. Does not write the SSN, create an invoice, file documents, or email anyone, and the automatic signed-and-paid opening will not run for this lead afterwards. Preview first; apply with confirm: true and the preview_id. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: Must be omitted or false on the first call — that only previews. Never invent a preview_id. After the person agrees, call again with confirm: true AND the preview_id this server returned.

file_no.description: The firm's File No for the new matter (digits).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result instead of writing again. Defaults to preview_id.

lead_id.description: Lead (intake-board task) id from list_recent_leads or find_matter.

preview_id.description: Exactly the preview_id this server returned on a prior call for these arguments. Required with confirm: true. Never generate or reuse one from another tool or conversation.

staff_override_reason.description: Required only to open before the retainer is signed and paid. Recorded on the lead.

name: create_matter
title: Open new matter
